findings.analysis: R09 emphasizes presence and accurate quotation of data anchors, but not whether the inference is valid. P10 directly compares 90% arrival/planned total against 86% paid/arrived, denominators defined differently on P02. Judge lists accurate quoted figures without inspecting that comparison.

P04 infrastructure water/electricity/road completion is 92.6%, basic compliance; P11 says infrastructure category completed. Judge awards full consistency/self-consistency marks and does not address the latter claim.

P12 explicitly sets some improvement/acceptance targets at 90% and reiterates 95% compliance threshold. A target of 90% does not alone prove the deck claims it is fully compliant; this part of human criticism should not be accepted without contextual qualification.
Judge deducts 6 for cover/date attribution and 7.5 for overlapping traceability labels. These do not by themselves establish that B is worse than A; inspect evidence separately before changing rules.

policy: Keep original human choice and model verdicts; no retrospective manual score correction.
